faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access to your plan features until the end of your current billing period.
faq.a2: When you submit a track, we match it with labels and curators in our network based on genre, quality, and commercial potential. If there's interest, we'll connect you directly.
faq.q3: What kind of feedback will I get?
faq.a3: Our AI analyzes your track and provides feedback on mixing, mastering, composition, arrangement, and more. Higher tier plans offer more detailed feedback and personalized recommendations.
faq.q4: Is there a free trial for premium plans?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial for both Artist and Pro plans. You won't be charged until the trial period ends, and you can cancel anytime.
